records.issue_text: [ADVISORY] containsHtml only matches lowercase opening tags (<[a-z]+[^>]*>), so an English source containing an uppercase tag or a lone closing tag is classified as HTML-free and every translation of it is held to POLICY_NO_HTML. Translations legitimately mirroring the English markup get false 'Illegal HTML' build failures (or, inversely, uppercase markup in English is never detected as the HTML source), biting maintainers of the ~50 locale files this verifier now gates.

`) or lone closing tags (e.g. `
